official_sources: Water voles protection surveys and licences
Water vole displacement class licence CL31
Water vole drainage and flood works class licence CL24
Protected species science education conservation licence A29

official_measurement_examples.name: Planning standing advice
official_measurement_examples.fact: Water-vole standing advice is a material planning consideration and was updated 7 April 2025.

official_measurement_examples.name: A11 mitigation scope
official_measurement_examples.fact: A11 is the mitigation route where work would affect water voles through disturbance, burrow damage, obstruction, taking, killing or injury within the licence criteria.

official_measurement_examples.name: CL31 displacement scope
official_measurement_examples.fact: CL31 is a class licence for defined displacement activity by registered persons and is not a general development licence.

official_measurement_examples.name: CL31 2026 validity
official_measurement_examples.fact: The current CL31 is valid from 1 January 2026 to 31 December 2030 and applies across England subject to its terms.

official_measurement_examples.name: Less-than-50-metre route
official_measurement_examples.fact: Standing advice states projects affecting less than 50 metres of bank may use an ecologist registered under CL31 where the licence conditions are met.

official_measurement_examples.name: Strategic licence trial closed
official_measurement_examples.fact: Natural England states the water-vole strategic licence trial closed on 30 June 2026 and other licensing routes remain available.

official_measurement_examples.name: A11 housing reasoned-statement caveat
official_measurement_examples.fact: A11 guidance contains housing-development exemptions from a reasoned statement but retains exceptions including specified translocation and watercourse-impact cases.

official_measurement_examples.name: Planning separation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Water-vole licences do not themselves grant planning permission, prove water-vole absence or establish parcel development capacity.

core_rules: water-vole protection law is not proof water voles are present on a parcel
water-vole survey result is not planning permission
planning permission is not an A11 mitigation licence
A11 mitigation licence is distinct from CL31 displacement class licence
CL24 drainage licence is distinct from CL31 development displacement
the 2025-2026 strategic licence trial is closed and must not be treated as a current open route
less than 50 metres of bank is a licence-route gate not a parcel clearance
planning standing advice is not a planning decision
historic water-vole survey must retain its date and survey scope
absence of recorded burrows is not proof of species absence without adequate evidence
licence conditions must be tied to actual works and dates
water-vole protection does not determine land ownership
licensing does not reserve development capacity
water-vole compliance does not create access rights
no parcel water-vole clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
